create_SetCriterion: create a SetCriterion module to compute DETR loss using hungarian assignment between ground truth boxes and model outputs
create_FocalLossSetCriterion: create a FocalLossSetCriterion module to compute DETR loss using focal loss instead of cross entropy for classification
review_SetCriterion_loss_labels: review the SetCriterion loss_labels method to understand how cross entropy classification loss is computed with empty class weighting
review_SetCriterion_loss_boxes: review the SetCriterion loss_boxes method to understand how L1 regression and GIoU losses are computed for bounding boxes
review_SetCriterion_loss_masks: review the SetCriterion loss_masks method to understand how focal loss and dice loss are computed for segmentation masks
